roles.name: Admin
roles.description: Has full access to the restaurant management system and can manage employees, settings, and operations.

roles.name: Cashier
roles.description: Handles customer payments, billing, receipts, and cashier operations.

roles.name: Waiter
roles.description: Handles customer service, table orders, food delivery, and communication with the kitchen.

roles.name: Chef
roles.description: Prepares food, manages kitchen operations, and maintains food quality and safety.

roles.name: Manager
roles.description: Assists with restaurant operations, staff management, customer service, and daily business activities.

roles.name: Staff
roles.description: Performs general restaurant tasks and supports daily restaurant operations.

departments.name: Management
departments.description: Responsible for restaurant administration, supervision, planning, and overall business operations.

departments.name: Front Office
departments.description: Handles customer-facing activities including payments, billing, reception, and cashier operations.

departments.name: Service
departments.description: Responsible for customer service, table management, order taking, and serving food and beverages.

departments.name: Kitchen
departments.description: Responsible for food preparation, cooking, kitchen operations, and food quality control.

positions.name: Restaurant Manager
positions.description: Manages the overall restaurant operation, staff, customer service, and business performance.

positions.name: Senior Cashier
positions.description: Handles cashier operations and assists with supervising other cashiers.

positions.name: Waiter
positions.description: Takes customer orders, serves food and beverages, and provides customer service.

positions.name: Waitress
positions.description: Provides table service, takes orders, serves customers, and maintains dining area service.

positions.name: Head Chef
positions.description: Leads the kitchen team, manages food preparation, menu execution, and kitchen quality.

positions.name: Sous Chef
positions.description: Assists the head chef with kitchen operations, food preparation, and supervision of kitchen staff.

positions.name: Cashier
positions.description: Processes customer payments, manages bills, and provides receipts.

positions.name: Assistant Manager
positions.description: Assists the restaurant manager with daily operations, staff coordination, and customer service.

positions.name: Restaurant Staff
positions.description: Supports daily restaurant operations and assists customers and other departments as needed.
